original_question: What placeholder name did the World Health Organization adopt in 2018 to represent a hypothetical unknown pathogen, similar to how 'X-ray' was historically used to describe an unexplained phenomenon?

final_qi.question: What placeholder name did the World Health Organization adopt in 2018 to represent a hypothetical unknown pathogen, similar to how 'X-ray' was historically used to describe an unexplained phenomenon?
final_qi.search_keyword: World Health Organization placeholder name 2018 unknown pathogen
final_qi.long_answer: The placeholder name adopted by the World Health Organization in 2018 is 'Disease X'. This term was introduced to represent a hypothetical unknown pathogen that might cause a future pandemic. The concept of Disease X serves as a reminder that there could be an outbreak from an as-yet unidentified infectious agent, helping to drive research and preparedness efforts for potential pandemics.
